unavailable.title: Can't reach the assistant
unavailable.description: The assistant isn't running, so this couldn't be loaded. This isn't an empty list.

error.title: Couldn't load this
error.description: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

changes.overlapped: May include changes from another chat that ran at the same time.
changes.undo_note: Undo restores this file to the checkpoint and reloads the page. | Undo restores these {count} files to the checkpoint and reloads the page.
changes.redo_note: Redo puts this file back as the assistant left it. | Redo puts these {count} files back as the assistant left them.
changes.empty_description: When the assistant edits a page or a file, the change set lands here with its diff and an undo.
changes.off_description: Git isn't available on this machine, so the assistant can't save checkpoints to undo its changes. Install Git and restart the assistant.

diff.binary: Binary file, no diff to show.

toast.undone_description: The page reloads with the files as they were. | {count} change sets were undone; the page reloads with the files as they were.

skills.shadowed_by: Ignored: {winner} has the same name and is used instead.
skills.shadowed_description: Ignored: another skill has the same name and is used instead.

welcome.title: Let’s build your back office
welcome.lede_before: Connect an AI model once, then describe what you need or start from a database you already have. You can reopen this anytime from the
welcome.ai_text: Use your existing subscription. About a minute.
welcome.start_text: From scratch, or from an existing database.
welcome.shape_text: Iterate on a live mockup, then build it for real.

ready.title: Your assistant is ready
ready.lede: We found an AI login on this machine. Use it, or pick another.
ready.other: Use Codex or another account instead

ai.title: Which AI do you use?
ai.lede: The assistant runs on your own subscription. Nothing is billed by us.
ai.found_claude: Found a Claude login on this machine ({email}). We’ll use it, no token needed.
ai.found_claude_plain: Found a Claude login on this machine. We’ll use it, no token needed.
ai.found_codex: Found a ChatGPT login on this machine ({email}). We’ll use it, no sign-in needed.
ai.found_codex_plain: Found a ChatGPT login on this machine. We’ll use it, no sign-in needed.
ai.expired_claude: Your Claude login has expired. Connect it again to keep using it.
ai.expired_codex: Your ChatGPT login has expired. Sign in again to keep using it.

claude.title: Connect Claude
claude.lede: Generate a long-lived token from your terminal and paste it here. We store it on this machine only.
claude.rejected: This token was rejected. Run the command again and paste the new token.
claude.unreachable: Anthropic could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
claude.malformed: This is not a Claude token. Paste the one the command prints, starting with sk-ant-.
claude.unsaved: The token works but could not be saved on this machine. Check that its configuration folder is writable, then try again.

codex.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
codex.lede: We open ChatGPT in a new tab. Approve the request and come back, this window updates by itself.
codex.remote_lede: After approving, your browser lands on a page that fails to load. Copy its full address and paste it here.
codex.unavailable: ChatGPT sign-in is not available yet. Reopen this window in a moment.

connected.lede: The assistant is ready. Next, tell us where you start from.

paths.title: Where do you start from?
paths.lede: Pick one. You can always do the other later.
paths.scratch_text: Describe your product. We draft a live mockup you refine before anything is built.
paths.database_text: Connect PostgreSQL, MongoDB or RethinkDB. We read the schema and propose the screens.

scratch.title: What are you building?
scratch.lede: A few sentences is enough. The assistant asks what it needs, then shows you a mockup.
scratch.placeholder: A back office for my bike rental shop: bikes, customers, rentals, and a dashboard of revenue per week…

database.title: Connect your database
database.lede: We only read the schema and a small sample until you allow more.
database.stored: Saved in your project’s .env, never sent anywhere else.
database.unreadable: This is not a {engine} connection URL.
database.schema_failed: The schema could not be read: {error}
database.empty: No table this user can read.
database.gave_up: The project did not come back. Restart it, then reopen this window.

analysis.title: Here’s what’s in
analysis.lede: {engine} · {tables} · read only for now. Untick what you don’t need.
